svg.title: svjeez
svg.desc: A hype reel for svjeez that follows the viewer's light or dark mode. Three words: prompt, animate, ship. In Claude Code, Claude reads the svjeez skill, writes a scene, renders frames, looks at them and ships an SVG. The scene's TSX streams into an editor while a preview draws each line's effect. A montage shows sampled motion, a typed flowchart, a word inked on as outlines and brush strokes. Three facts: zero bytes of runtime JS, one self-contained file, CSS and SMIL. The svjeez logo draws on above the install command.

g.text: 02 — CLAUDE WRITES TSX. SVJEEZ COMPILES IT.
any function of time, baked into keyframes
real fonts, as outlines you can draw on
hand-inked strokes: pen, brush, nib and pencil
this entire video is one 214 KB SVG. no video file, no JavaScript.
